question: Identify the state abbreviations where, for both male and female legislators, the retention rate remains greater than zero at specific intervals of 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10 years after their first term start date. A legislator is considered retained if they are serving on December 31 of the respective year. Only include states where both gender cohorts maintain non-zero retention rates at all six of these time points during the first decade of service.
sql:
-- Count total states
WITH first_terms AS (
    SELECT id_bioguide, MIN(term_start) as first_term_start
    FROM legislators_terms 
    GROUP BY id_bioguide
),
checkpoints AS (
    SELECT 0 as year_offset UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 10
),
legislator_checkpoints AS (
    SELECT 
        ft.id_bioguide,
        ft.first_term_start,
        c.year_offset,
        CAST(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(ft.first_term_start AS DATE)) + c.year_offset AS INTEGER) AS VARCHAR) || '-12-31' as dec31_date
    FROM first_terms ft
    CROSS JOIN checkpoints c
),
retained AS (
    SELECT 
        lc.id_bioguide,
        lc.first_term_start,
        lc.year_offset,
        lc.dec31_date,
        CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt
            WHERE lt.id_bioguide = lc.id_bioguide
            AND lt.term_start <= lc.dec31_date
            AND lt.term_end >= lc.dec31_date
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as is_retained
    FROM legislator_checkpoints lc
),
state_gender_retention AS (
    SELECT 
        lt.state,
        l.gender,
        r.year_offset,
        1.0 * SUM(r.is_retained) / COUNT(*) as retention_rate
    FROM retained r
    JOIN legislators_terms lt ON r.id_bioguide = lt.id_bioguide AND lt.term_start = r.first_term_start
    JOIN legislators l ON r.id_bioguide = l.id_bioguide
    GROUP BY lt.state, l.gender, r.year_offset
),
qualifying AS (
    SELECT state, gender,
        CASE WHEN MIN(retention_rate) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as all_positive
    FROM state_gender_retention
    GROUP BY state, gender
)
SELECT q1.state
FROM qualifying q1
JOIN qualifying q2 ON q1.state = q2.state
WHERE q1.gender = 'M' AND q1.all_positive = 1
  AND q2.gender = 'F' AND q2.all_positive = 1
ORDER BY q1.state
